author: Unity
description:
A Cinemachine 2D Confiner keeps a 2D camera’s view locked within a defined boundary shape so the camera never shows areas outside your level or play space. In this tip, we’ll show you how to set that up.

Watch our Cinemachine video tutorial series: https://on.unity.com/CinemachineTutorials

Find more free Unity learn resources: https://on.unity.com/Learn
title: Unity 6 tips: Cinemachine 2D Confiners short #gamedev #unitytips #unity3d #unitylearn #gameengine
